title: Imagery / Characters
slide_intent: Represent different people through expressive figures because an inclusive promise should be visible in who appears in the work.
strategic_value: A varied character cast can make Duolingo’s “everyone” positioning tangible while keeping a shared illustration style.
demonstration: Character examples accompany guidance on multicultural representation, enthusiastic poses and occasional cropping to focus expression or action.
practical_value: Choose an expressive pose and consider a crop when it clarifies mood or activity.
